title: Đề luyện Nói VSTEP — Recall SGU0822

questions.content:
speaking — Part 1

Part 1: Social Interaction You will answer questions about two topics. Answer each question naturally. Topic 1 - Sports 1. What sport do you like most? 2. Which sport would you like to play in the future? 3. Do you like watching sports programmes on TV? Topic 2 - Food 1. What is your favourite food to eat? 2. Do you usually cook it yourself or eat out? 3. Do you often eat out?

speaking — Part 2

Situation: You and a friend want to have a meal together and must decide what dish to eat. You are considering the following options: 1. Fried rice 2. Beef pho (phở bò) 3. Fresh spring rolls (gỏi cuốn) Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: The benefits of travelling in a group (group travel). Ideas: - Safety - Saving money - Expanding your social circle (meeting new people) - Your own idea (for example, sharing responsibilities and having more fun) Further questions: 1. What are the disadvantages of group travel? 2. How is travelling in a group with friends different from travelling with family? 3. How can members of a travel group come to understand each other's personal culture?
